scope.reason: Recompute procedural review links from the publisher's review table on every held detail page and from the stored opening and holding text; document-only legacy raw retains its existing metadata. A running footer or header that counts its pages after its words (`… 2/13`, `… 2 z 13`) is compared without the count, so it is read as one repeated line and leaves the body, and a paragraph the page break crossed joins again; the AST has no separate feature storage.
